issue.title: Bug: dhcp_relay tests are failing against isolated topologies and should be skipped instead

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

The DHCP Relay tests are not applicable to the isolated topologies, so skip them.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the dhcp_relay tests against and isolated topology.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior: The tests fail
Expected Behavior: The tests should be actively skipped rather than failing.

resolution.title: Skip dhcp_relay Tests for Isolated Topologies
resolution.description:
### Description of PR
Summary: The DHCP Relay tests are not applicable to the isolated topologies, so skip them.
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/26001

### Type of change
- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205

- [x] 202511

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The DHCP Relay tests should be skipped for isolated topologies.

#### How did you do it?
Added a skip condition to the tests_mark_conditions file for isolated topologies.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran dhcp_relay tests against an isolated topology and confirmed that all the tests are skipped.
